name: com.tarinoi.unity
description: Tarinoi dialogue for Unity. Syncs authored dialogue content from the Tarinoi service into a local SQLite database, evaluates authored conditions and functions against your game's bindings, and drives dialogue playback through a simple event-based runtime.

samples.description: A start-card picker and scrolling dialogue feed built with UGUI. The fastest way to see Tarinoi content playing in your project.
